profile.description: 2026 International Camel & Ostrich Races prospect. Family-focused three-day event September 11-13, 2026 at the Virginia City Fairgrounds. Event includes four race shows, Sunday Family Day, food trucks, craft/art vendors and other entertainment. 2026 vendor management contact is Liquid Blue Events at team@liquidblueevents.com / 775-851-4444. Adventure Zone outreach is for a possible pay-for-play seven-piece inflatable family attraction area.
